title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
summary: Central GST charging, registration, supply, tax invoices, input tax credit, assessments and returns framework; amendments, rules and notifications require date-specific review.

title: Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
summary: IGST charging law and inter-State supplies; use with place-of-supply rules and current notifications.

title: Goa Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
summary: Official Goa GST Act library; relevant to intra-State Goa supplies together with the CGST Act and state notifications.

title: Goa GST amendments 2025 (first and second Acts)
summary: Goa State Tax lists Goa GST Amendment Act 2025 (Act 3 of 2025) and Second Amendment Act 2025 (Act 9 of 2025). Check individual commencement clauses/notifications before applying.

title: 56th GST Council recommendations and rate restructuring (Sept 2025)
summary: Council recommended GST rate changes. A recommendation is not, by itself, an operative rate notification; verify enacted Central/State notifications and service classification.

title: Official FAQs following 56th Council meeting
summary: Government FAQ states most notified rate changes were intended from 22 September 2025; always cross-check exact sector, notification, commencement and Goa counterpart.

title: 57th GST Council recommendations (8 October 2026)
summary: Recommends GST registration, reconciliation/IMS, input tax credit/refunds, penalties and adjudication reforms. Do not treat recommended amendments as enacted, even when suggested effective dates appear.

title: 57th GST Council FAQs (October 2026)
summary: Frequently asked questions concerning 57th Council recommendations; helpful interpretation only; check implementing laws/notifications.

title: Recommended GSTR-1/3B and ITC alignment from April 2027 returns
summary: 57th Council recommended a revised liability and ITC correction mechanism beginning with April 2027 return; implementing rules must be confirmed before coding it.

title: Recommended optional scheme for consumer-facing businesses up to INR 5 crore
summary: In-principle optional scheme discussed in 57th Council for qualifying small consumer-facing businesses; not an enforceable election until law/rules and eligibility are notified.

title: Recommended prosecution and general-penalty reforms (57th Council)
summary: Council proposed reducing general penalty ceiling and modifying prosecution provisions. The proposed amounts must never replace current enacted law automatically.

title: GSTR-1 official return guide and filing calendar
summary: GST Portal describes normal GSTR-1 due date: 11th of succeeding month for monthly and 13th following quarter for quarterly filing, subject to extensions.

title: Prior-year invoice correction timing in GSTR-1
summary: GST Portal guidance identifies a 30 November cut-off in following financial year for previous-year GSTR-1 invoice corrections; check year-specific laws and any extension.

title: GSTR-3B official return guide
summary: Summary GST return and liability discharge. Portal gives normal monthly due date 20th of next month and state-specific quarterly dates; verify live calendar for Goa.

title: QRMP scheme eligibility and procedure
summary: QRMP guidance: annual aggregate turnover up to INR 5 crore subject to conditions, quarterly GSTR-1/3B and monthly tax payment; check eligibility and filing preference.

title: 2026 GSTR-3B interest-calculator enhancement
summary: From January 2026 tax period the portal introduced interest calculation enhancement considering qualifying minimum electronic cash ledger balance; review Rule 88B and advisory.

title: Input tax credit controls require invoice and GSTR-2B reconciliation
summary: Review section 16, blocked-credit section 17(5), CGST rules, matching conditions, reversals and current portal IMS before recognizing ITC.

title: Moksha wellness, sauna, baths and yoga service classification review
summary: Do not assume a single GST rate for sauna, ice bath, mud rituals, yoga, retreats or bundled hospitality. Classify each supply/SAC, bundled supply, exemption and notified rate with accountant review.

title: Income-tax Act, 2025 as amended by Finance Act, 2026
summary: New Income-tax Act applies from 1 April 2026, subject to savings and transition provisions; source linked to official consolidated Act amended by Finance Act 2026.

title: Income-tax Rules, 2026 official index
summary: Rules 2026 notified 20 March 2026 to operationalise Income-tax Act 2025; verify relevant rule and form from official index.

title: Income tax 1961 to 2025 transition FAQ
summary: Guidance: credit or payment before 1 April 2026 generally uses relevant 1961 Act withholding law; from 1 April 2026 consult section 393 of 2025 Act. Check actual event dates.

title: Official TDS rates for tax year 2026-27
summary: Official 2025 Act TDS table as amended by Finance Act 2026. Check exact Section 393 table item, deductee status, payment type and threshold.

title: TDS rates under the 1961 Act, including AY 2026-27
summary: Legacy section references, such as 194C/194J/194H, remain important for pre-transition transactions. Do not quote legacy section in post-1-April-2026 filings without transition check.

title: Official commencement of Income-tax Act 2025
summary: CBDT announced commencement of Income-tax Act 2025 on 1 April 2026 and Income-tax Rules 2026 issued 20 March 2026.

title: Official Income-tax Act 2025 and Rules 2026 reference portal
summary: Primary portal for latest law, 1961-to-2025 mapping, rules, forms and transition FAQs; review before each income-tax case.

title: GST Council official press release register
summary: Official chronologically dated GST Council press releases for change detection. Council recommendations are not automatically binding.

title: Goa State Tax GST Acts and amendments official catalogue
summary: State government source for Goa-specific GST Acts and amendments; verify notification effective dates per enactment.

title: GST Portal as operational filing reference
summary: Use GST Portal for current taxpayer filing status, return utilities, advisories and actual due-date extensions; website may require authentication.

title: Income-tax Department updates and circulars hub
summary: Monitor for Finance Acts, forms, circulars, deadlines and rules. Official gazette/law prevails over educational summaries.

title: E-invoice applicability and threshold: case-specific verification required
summary: Before enabling IRN generation, verify taxpayer's PAN-level aggregate turnover, current notification threshold, exemptions, supplies, and registration details; no assumed universal threshold.
